page_title: ROM 3-1 GEN | AS Roma v Genoa 17/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Matias Soule (AS Roma) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar.
90+3' The linesman points to the corner flag, AS Roma are going to take it.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' A great solo run by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort low towards the middle of the goal was easily caught by Nicola Leali.
85' The manager makes a subsitution with Lior Kasa (Genoa) coming on for Fabio Miretti.
85' Claudio Ranieri decides to make a substitution. Artem Dovbyk will be replaced by Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma).
84' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Paulo Dybala walks off the pitch to be replaced by Matias Soule (AS Roma).
83' Lorenzo Venturino (Genoa) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
79' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) sends in a close-range first-time shot. It's a poor effort which sails miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
76' Claudio Ranieri has decided to make a change. Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) replaces Mats Hummels.
76' Here's the change. Alexis Saelemaekers leaves the pitch and Zeki Celik (AS Roma) comes on as a substitute.
73' 3 - 1 Nicola Leali (Genoa) puts the ball into the back of the net but, unfortunately for him and his teammates, it's into his own goal!
72' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
71' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Mile Svilar.
68' Patrick Vieira has decided to substitute Alessandro Zanoli and he is replaced by Lorenzo Venturino (Genoa).
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) replaces Morten Thorsby.
67' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety.

64' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar.
64' The ball is out of play and Genoa manage to earn a corner.
63' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
63' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 11:3.

60' 2 - 1 Paulo Dybala passes to Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom right corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 2:1.
59' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
56' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Luca Zufferli had an easy-decision to make.
56' AS Roma get a corner.
55' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) commits a foul and Luca Zufferli immediately signals a free kick.
53' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle after Mats Hummels (AS Roma) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
51' Aaron Martin (Genoa) is flagged for offside.
49' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.

48' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Luca Zufferli blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
46' Claudio Ranieri is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Lorenzo Pellegrini suffers an injury and Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) comes on.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) tries his luck from a long-range free kick and the ball is aimed to low to the middle, but Nicola Leali is alert and thwarts the effort.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
42' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
40' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
40' Angelino (AS Roma) commits a rough foul. Luca Zufferli stops the game and makes a call.
36' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
33' 1 - 1 What a hit! Patrizio Masini (Genoa) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot low into the middle of the net. 1:1.
32' Mattia Bani is being substituted because of an injury. Patrick Vieira sends Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) on the pitch.
32' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Genoa.
29' Mattia Bani (Genoa) picks up an injury.
25' 1 - 0 Goal! The rebound fell to Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) and he fired home from close range. The score is 1:0.
25' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) meets an accurate cross in the box and steers a fine header towards the net. The goalkeeper has to react quickly to keep the ball out.
22' Artem Dovbyk loses the ball after receiving a sweet pass from Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma).
21' What a miskick by Mats Hummels (AS Roma). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
20' The ball possession is 65:35.
18' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Johan Vasquez (Genoa) was quite harsh and Luca Zufferli didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
16' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Mile Svilar easily makes the save.
15' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) sends a long ball in, but Nicola Leali comfortably gathers the ball.
15' AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
13' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) brings his opponent down. Luca Zufferli has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His rocket of a shot crashes against the crossbar! What a shot.
8' Poor challenge! Morten Frendrup (Genoa) is penalised for tripping and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle. AS Roma have a free kick from a promising distance.
4' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.

2' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) drills a shot towards goal after the ball is whipped into the penalty area, but it goes miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
AS Roma will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Luca Zufferli.
